title: Meta-labeling size tilt on ATLAS members (EMA + MACD + S/R) (L2 logistic, rank map x0.5-x1.5)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: can quant / ML meta-labeling (learn when a signal is likely to win, size it up or down) improve the strategies?
verdict: OOS AUC 0.669 (2026 H2 frozen 0.667); best model of the family lr_all AUC 0.669 permutation p 0.0099 (H2 0.1881). 2021-25 n=1220 net +39,513 vs flat +41,775, 2-wk 20.0/43.6 vs 25.0/47.5, beats random sizing in 64.0%; 2026 H2 n=57 net +16,412 vs flat +13,619, 2-wk 43.6/15.4 vs 34.6/6.4, beats random sizing in 80.5%. Strict pass: False.
notes: tools/meta_label.py; research/quant/meta/atlas.json; sized at the strategy's own size rule x the multiplier (P&L linear in micros); trades = walk-forward OOS span trades (untested months at x1).

params.map: m = 0.5 + percentile of p among the training predictions

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
